report_name: Kiteworks Urges Shutdown After Warning of Imminent Cyberattack

threat_actors.name: Clop
threat_actors.description: The Clop ransomware group was mentioned in the context of its historical supply-chain attack against Accellion, Kiteworks' predecessor, which involved exploiting multiple zero-day vulnerabilities.

vulnerabilities.name: Potential Kiteworks Zero-Day Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: A potential, unconfirmed zero-day vulnerability in the Kiteworks platform that prompted a preventative shutdown advisory based on federal intelligence. No patch was available at the time of the warning.

identities.name: Kiteworks
identities.description: A secure file-transfer vendor that issued an urgent advisory for customers to shut down their systems based on a federal warning of a potential imminent cyberattack.

identities.name: Accellion
identities.description: The predecessor company to Kiteworks, which was the target of a major supply-chain attack by the Clop ransomware group in 2020-2021.

identities.name: Frank Balonis
identities.description: CISO of Kiteworks, who stated the shutdown measure was precautionary.

identities.name: U.S. federal authorities
identities.description: Unspecified U.S. federal intelligence authorities that provided Kiteworks with credible threat intelligence about a potential imminent attack.

indicators.name: Suspicious Child Process Spawned by Kiteworks Service
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Child Process Spawned by Kiteworks Service
id: 2a1b3c4d-5e6f-4a9b-8c7d-6e5f4a3b2c1d
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of command-line interpreters (cmd.exe, bash) as a child process of a Kiteworks application service, which could indicate post-exploitation activity following a zero-day exploit.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-26
references:
  - https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/kiteworks-urges-6-hour-server-shutdown-over-potential-zero-day-attacks/
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection:
    ParentImage|contains: 'kiteworks' # Placeholder for actual Kiteworks process name
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '/bash'
      - '/sh'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects command-line interpreters being spawned by the main Kiteworks application process, which is anomalous and could indicate post-exploitation activity.

relationships.source_name: Suspicious Child Process Spawned by Kiteworks Service
